title: AdSense readiness, build-time SSG prerendering, and Geography Explorer hub
body:
ADSENSE READINESS & SEO ENHANCEMENT
- Introduced build-time SSG prerendering (prerender.py) generating crawlable HTML for core static pages, guides, and policies to pass Google AdSense indexing.
- Hardened AdSense unit component with responsive layouts and non-intrusive container sizing.

GEOGRAPHY EXPLORER HUB & MODE GUIDES
- Added Geography Explorer hub (/explore) featuring searchable, filterable country and geography intelligence.
- Created dedicated interactive Mode Guides (/modes/:mode) with comprehensive rules, strategies, and tips for all game modes.
- Added backend explorer APIs (/api/explore) providing aggregated entity statistics, facts, and region groupings.
